DELTA STATE (PSI 8.8): Delta State Begins N5 Billion Grassroots Empowerment Grant for 100,000 Business Owners Across 500 Wards
KWARA STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor AbdulRazaq Flags Off Inputs for 49,337 Farmers, Reaching 235,567 Beneficiaries Under FADAMA CARES
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.7): Enugu LGA Chairmen Resolve to Pay Inherited Gratuity Arrears Dating Back Two Decades Starting November
OSUN STATE (PSI 8.6): Osun Government Escalates Flood-Risk Assessments and Drainage Clearances in Ede North Following NiMet Forecasts
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 8.6): Governor Diri Approves Hosting of DeltasUNite Governance Secretariat at UN Ocean Conference in Shanghai
OGUN STATE (PSI 8.5): Governor Abiodun Swears In Two Commissioners; State Takes Vulnerable Child into Protective Custody
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.5): Governor Sanwo-Olu Swears In Six Permanent Secretaries and Members of Audit and LG Service Commissions
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 8.4): Governor Namadi Highlights NYSC Camp Upgrades and Issues Zero-Rejection Directive Across MDAs
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.0): Adamawa Pledges Tech Incubation Collaboration and Repairs Storm-Damaged Electricity Poles at Malkohi
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.8): Zamfara State Donates 500 Bags of Grains to Displaced Bukuyum Communities Following Banditry Attacks
KATSINA (PSI 9.2): Launched Katsina-One-Tree Initiative targeting 11 million trees by 2030, and rolled out grants for 62,000 MSMEs with 2,000 kiosks.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.1): Flagged off Carnival dry run, launched Coffee Festival rally, concluded SPIN irrigation workshop, and assessed flood damage in Biase.
EDO (PSI 9.0): Commissioned Ewatto hospital annex of Irrua Specialist Hospital, trained MDAs on SHINE budget, and evaluated UBTH fire casualties.
DELTA (PSI 8.8): Initiated N5bn empowerment scheme disbursing N50,000 grants to 100,000 small business owners across 500 wards under MORE Agenda.
KWARA (PSI 8.8): Flagged off agricultural inputs and processing machinery for 49,337 farmers, bringing total beneficiaries to 235,567.
ENUGU (PSI 8.7): All 17 LGA Chairmen resolved to commence payment of inherited retirement gratuity arrears dating back 20+ years in November 2026.
OSUN (PSI 8.6): Intensified flood-risk assessments in Ede North LGA following NiMet forecasts, enforcing drainage clearance and stormwater planning.
BAYELSA (PSI 8.6): Approved hosting DeltasUNite Secretariat in Bayelsa during 5th UN Ocean Conference in Shanghai to advance global delta preservation.
OGUN (PSI 8.5): Swore in two Executive Commissioners and took a vulnerable wandering child into government protective custody for medical care.
LAGOS (PSI 8.5): Swore in six Permanent Secretaries and members of the Audit Service and Local Government Service Commissions.
JIGAWA (PSI 8.4): Inspected NYSC camp facility upgrades in Fanisau and issued a strict zero-rejection directive to state MDAs and LGAs.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.0): Pledged deeper collaboration with Technology Incubation Centre and inspected storm-damaged power pole repairs at Malkohi Estate.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.8): Donated 500 bags of grains to communities displaced by banditry in Bukuyum LGA and paid condolences over lost security personnel.
